scope: Sessions of the 1st–42nd Parliaments: older official compilations, completed from 40th session 2 through the 42nd Parliament using original Journals.
method: Date cells extracted by x coordinate and matching row y coordinate; all nine session-table page images visually inspected. Later supplement supersedes earlier truncated Parliament table. Original-Journals follow-up is documented in later_sessions_review.json; it supersedes the incomplete 40th-session-2 compilation row and adds fourteen sessions.

field_semantics.opened_on: For the older compilation rows, the first date in the printed session range (explicitly headed OPENING DAY in R3R-030); for the fifteen later rows, the date of the original opening Journals entry.
field_semantics.session_end_as_printed: For the older compilation rows, the second printed session-range date, whose event type remains flagged where unlabelled. For the fifteen original-Journals rows, the operative date in the explicit prorogation or dissolution entry, which can be later than the cover/catalogue endpoint.
field_semantics.prorogued_on: Filled when an older compilation explicitly labels PROROGATION DAY or when an original Journals entry explicitly records prorogation. These evidence classes remain separate in each row.
field_semantics.prorogation_candidate_from_session_table: Older R3R-007 and R3R-029 give unlabelled session ranges. Their end dates are retained here for review rather than silently asserting they are a formally labelled prorogation event.
field_semantics.dissolved_on: For Parliaments 1–39, the separately printed official-compilation dissolution date; for Parliaments 40–42, the operative day in an original proclamation reproduced in the Journals. Not inferred from a last sitting.
field_semantics.null: Not stated or not explicitly established by the supplied source. Does not mean ongoing today.
field_semantics.not_sitting_days: R3R-007 printed p553 footnote expressly warns that not all days during a session were sitting days.
field_semantics.last_sitting_on: Recorded only for the three final sessions whose last sitting precedes dissolution; this is an adjournment, not a formal end of the session.
field_semantics.prorogued_on_null: No prorogation asserted for a session ended by the separately proved dissolution.
field_semantics.summoning_proclamation_issued_on_as_reci: Summoning date recited in the opening entry, distinct from the actual opening date.

limits: The 157 retained older compilation rows have not been checked individually against original Journals entries. The fifteen later rows have been checked in original Journals.
The earlier two tables have no explicit opening/prorogation column headings; their raw ranges are preserved and endpoint event type is flagged for review.
A session range is not a record of daily sittings, recesses, adjournments, or continuous legislative activity.
This addendum does not cover the 43rd or 44th Parliament and makes no election-result assumption.
No full committee roster or daily sitting calendar was extracted.
An adjournment does not itself establish a prorogation or dissolution.
